ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe distal section: large contiguous white area with numerous internal dark circular voids. Left lobe: predominantly dark with small fragmented white mottling at the distal tip. Proximal areas of both lobes are consistently low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees and a depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 4 to 12 pixels, most pronounced on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve extending from the median notch, transitioning into an upward convex sweep at the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular high-contrast spots; dark spots on white background (right lobe distal) and white spots on dark background (central and left regions).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear markings detected on the dark proximal surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes consistent with barnacle colonization; irregular edge erosion at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The large, high-contrast white distal patch on the right lobe serves as a primary unique identifier.
